caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a flat lid and beveled edges. The box is rendered in shades of brown, with the central panels on the front and side faces a lighter brown, bordered by darker brown or black lines with decorative corner accents. The top face of the box is also lighter brown in the center with a similar border design. There is a small white circular detail, possibly a keyhole or button, on the front face. On the left side, there is an ornate white or cream-colored emblem or plaque. The box sits on a slightly lighter brown or beige surface, and the background is plain off-white with some scattered brownish specks and marks. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
